g.text: Sieve · 4 learnings ready to review · /sieve
/sieve
From 2 conversations since Oct 13. Nothing like these is in the repo yet.
Rule
Test anything that writes against a copy of the project data,
never the real database.
Oct 13 · “Backend ready and tested on a copy of the data”
Rule
Test view changes against a server started before the change too;
an old server must get an error with Retry, not a blank screen.
Oct 14 · “The black screen came from the server opened before the fix”
Insight
The view ships as one built HTML file. Edits to the React source
do nothing until it is rebuilt and copied.
Oct 13 · “vite-plugin-singlefile builds into one HTML file”
Insight
Nodes store their stage by index; editing stages must warn with
the number of nodes that will move.
Oct 13 · “93 nodes will move to a different stage”
2 conversations go to the log. 5 personal preferences set aside.
Which ones should I keep?
all but 4
